# Third-party assets

## Kenney — sound effects and jingles

Recorded sound effects from five packs by Kenney Vleugels (www.kenney.nl), released under
**Creative Commons Zero (CC0)**: public domain, free for personal and commercial use, no attribution
required. Credited anyway.

- Casino Audio — https://kenney.nl/assets/casino-audio
- Impact Sounds — https://kenney.nl/assets/impact-sounds
- RPG Audio — https://kenney.nl/assets/rpg-audio
- Interface Sounds — https://kenney.nl/assets/interface-sounds
- Music Jingles (victory and defeat) — https://kenney.nl/assets/music-jingles

`kenney-License.txt` is the licence text shipped in the packs. Which file became which effect is in
`art/audio/install_kenney.sh` and `art/audio/install_cc0.sh`.

## OpenGameArt — music and sound effects

All released under **Creative Commons Zero (CC0)**. Installed by `art/audio/install_cc0.sh`.

- "Cynic Battle Loop" by Ferk — combat music — https://opengameart.org/content/cynic-battle-loop
- "Epic Boss Battle [Seamlessly Looping]" by Juhani Junkala (SubspaceAudio) — boss music —
  https://opengameart.org/content/boss-battle-music
- "Dark Shrine Loop" by qubodup and yd — map music — https://opengameart.org/content/dark-shrine-loop
- Fire crackling by AntumDeluge — Burn — https://opengameart.org/content/fire-crackling
- "80 CC0 RPG SFX" by rubberduck — Overheat, relic, buff — https://opengameart.org/content/80-cc0-rpg-sfx

## Fonts

Noto Naskh Arabic UI (SIL Open Font License) and DejaVu Sans (Bitstream Vera licence), both in
`Assets/EmberDeck/Resources/Fonts`. See `docs/localization.md`.
